item.title: fix(tui): stop local shell descendants on exit (#127652)
item.summary: fix(tui): stop local shell descendants on exit (#127652) * fix(tui): own local shell process scopes Keep local shell root results independent from authoritative process-scope extinction, and make TUI shutdown cancel and join its ProcessSupervisor scope. On Windows, create commands atomically inside a retained non-breakaway Job Object and prove extinction from exact Job accounting. Fixes #127488 * fix(process): preserve optional extinction waits
